profiles.variant: Eight-zone Standard operator fascia — DFU7001020 Rev 2
limitations: A fictional eight-zone training configuration, not an electrical panel emulator or a live system connection.
No engineering access, walk-test programming, coincidence, non-latching programming or commissioning settings are implemented. Those require the applicable engineering manual.
Configured output delays are not supplied by the normal fixture; no field delay setting or acceptance value is inferred.
The fixture explicitly enables resound on a new zone. The manual describes this as programmable, not universal.
This is the Standard fascia/edition. Shared images do not establish Economy or AlarmSense compatibility.

profiles.variant: K11080M2 eight-zone K-series; sigma_CP 214.hex or later warning scope — Man-1078 Issue 25
limitations: A fictional eight-zone K-series fixture with common alarm operation and no configured delays. It is not a T-series wiring or CP-A AlarmSense simulator.
Active-device warning on a disabled zone is scoped to sigma_CP 214.hex or later, as stated by the main manual. It is not assumed for older panels.
The manuals say to press Mode until a code is shown but do not establish the complete cycle order. An explicit training target chooser avoids inventing a hardware press count.
Test auto-reset is described only as after a few seconds. Advancing a training test cycle does not certify a hardware timer.
No access-level-three Write Enable switch, engineering configuration, hardware fault injection or circuit measurements are implemented.
The source user guide has an Issue 06 cover and _05 page footers. This discrepancy is retained; the newer Issue 25 main manual is the primary operator reference.
The existing catalogue records do not pin the Sigma download hashes; compare a saved/downloaded edition with the checked source.
